moving_volume_dimension_rule: TCP path span on each axis + 2 * padding_each_side_mm
notes: The 70 mm example was for a standard 20 mm cup plus clearance only, not the complete mounted assembly.
357.2 mm per axis is a necessary stationary size under the configured sphere model, not a complete ten-pose motion plan.
Do not replace measured boundaries with these design dimensions without physically establishing the corresponding free space.
